title: Casse-Robot block type
description: A block type: a 0.5 m cell of a robot (or a thinner plate, or a shape cut out of the cube). A block is destroyed when its hit points reach 0. One file per block type: content/blocks/<type>.json, named after the type's identifier (a robot design's `blocks[].type`), read by the game as it is (src/shared/catalog/blocks.ts), with its unlock price. The shaped blocks (wedges, corners, rounds…) have no file: the game cuts them out of the light, normal and heavy armors, their mass, hit points and cost in proportion to their volume. Adding a type also takes its look, its name in each language and its sentence in the garage (docs/architecture.md, "Architecture rules"). Generated from the game's code (npm run schemas). Units: meters, kilograms, seconds, radians, newtons.

$schema.description: The schema of this file's family (content/schemas/<family>.schema.json), relative to the file, for the editor of whoever edits it. The game ignores it, like every field whose name starts with `$`.

$comment.description: A note for whoever edits this file (why the values are what they are). The game ignores it.

price.description: Unlock price (credits); 0: available from the start.

cost.description: Build cost: a robot's blocks and wheels must stay within the budget (`constants.robotBudget`).

bond.description: Strength of its links with its neighbors (N·m·s): the shock a single link (a neck, a one-block-wide arm) withstands before it breaks; a link is as strong as the weaker of its two blocks.

resist.description: Damage factor per kind of damage.

shape.description: Its shape: a full cube (the default), a thin plate perpendicular to the block's top (wings), or a shape cut out of the cube (`shapes`).

capacity.description: Energy stored (kJ), for the engines, the electric weapons, the shield…

radar.description: A radar: its team spots enemies within its range, through walls and smoke.

jammer.description: A jammer: an enemy radar no longer spots the robot beyond this range.

flares.description: A flare launcher: salvos of flares that decoy enemy missiles.

reload.description: Each salvo comes back after this time (s).

melee.description: The melee weapon whose motor and hub it is (`melee`).

resistances.description: Damage factor per kind of damage (1 when absent; below 1 it resists, above 1 it is sensitive).

additionalProperties.description: Factor applied to the damage of this kind.

thruster.description: An engine: it pushes toward the top of its block (up: lift; forward: propulsion; sideways: a tail rotor).

spoolTime.description: Response time (s): the thrust follows the setting with this lag.

torqueRatio.description: Reaction torque of the propeller per newton of thrust (N·m/N): on a multirotor they cancel out.

power.description: Electric power drawn at full thrust (kW), from the batteries.

gimbal.description: Tilt rotor: the thrust can tilt up to this angle (rad) on each side of the block's axis.

look.description: Its look and sound: rotor blades, an airplane propeller in front of its block, a turbojet nacelle; a flame when absent.

topSpeed.description: Propeller: its thrust falls as the air comes along its axis, down to 0 at this speed (m/s).

exhaust.description: Flame jet of a flame engine: what is behind its nozzle heats up.
The flame jet of an engine: its length follows the engine's speed (a quarter of `reach` at idle); fire damage, strongest at the nozzle.

nozzle.description: Distance from the block's center to the end of the nozzle (m).

reach.description: Length of the jet at full speed, beyond the nozzle (m).

dps.description: Damage per second (before resistance) at the nozzle, at full speed.

radius.description: Radius of the jet at the nozzle (m).

flare.description: What the radius gains per meter (m/m).

afterburner.description: Engine speed (share of the maximum thrust) beyond which the afterburner lengthens the jet by half and makes it a third hotter.

aero.description: A lifting surface (a flat plate one cell wide): lift = ½·ρ·V²·area·CL(α), CL = slope·α up to the stall.

maxDeflection.description: Maximum deflection (rad) of a control surface.

turret.description: A turret: a head that turns independently of the robot (yaw around the block's top, pitch above its horizon) and carries a weapon.

minPitch.description: Lowest pitch (rad), relative to the block's plane.

height.description: Height of the head's axis above the block's center (m; negative: the head hangs below).

barrel.description: Length of the barrel from the head's axis to the muzzle (m).

head.description: Dimensions of the head (m: width, height, depth), centered on its axis: its hitbox.

caliber.description: Diameter of the barrel (m): the hitbox of the barrel.

fixed.description: A fixed turret: it drops its ammunition behind the block (mine layer) or under it (bomb bay), without aiming.

support.description: A support without a wheel: a hover pad (it glides, it draws power) or a leg (it grips, it steps over obstacles).

reach.description: How far down it measures the ground (m).

ratedLoad.description: Rated load (kg), for which its spring is tuned.

traction.description: Grip: maximum horizontal force, as a share of the bearing force.

power.description: Power drawn under the rated load (kW).

repair.description: A repair module: when the robot hasn't been hit for `delay` s, it mends its damaged blocks and wheels nearby, and regrows lost blocks.

rate.description: Hit points restored per second, in all.

delay.description: Time without being hit before it works (s).

shield.description: A shield generator: while the robot has energy, it absorbs a share of the damage taken by its blocks nearby.

light.description: A light (headlight, beacon, aircraft lights): no effect in the simulation; at night it lights the scene.

kind.description: A cone along the top of the block, all around, or a cone that turns around the top of the block (a rotating light).

color.description: Its color: warm, white, red, amber, blue; team: its team's; side: red on the robot's left, green on its right, white in the middle; police: blue and red.

pattern.description: Its rhythm: steady, a slow pulse, short flashes, a double flash, alternating, rotating.
